title: Extract fieldwork::collections module
description:
ActivityPub OrderedCollection and OrderedCollectionPage construction with pagination. ~110 lines duplicated in server.rs outbox handlers across all three projects.

Source: BS server.rs:504-615 (outbox handler), GJ/SH activitypub.rs (similar).

Public API:
- build_ordered_collection(id: &str, total_items: i64, first_page_url: Option<&str>) -> serde_json::Value — top-level collection with totalItems and optional first link
- build_ordered_collection_page(id: &str, part_of: &str, items: Vec<serde_json::Value>, next_page_url: Option<&str>, prev_page_url: Option<&str>) -> serde_json::Value — paginated page with orderedItems
- PaginationParams { page: Option<u32>, page_size: u32 } — validated pagination (reject page=0)
- paginate_url(base_url: &str, page: u32) -> String — construct paginated URL

What stays in consumers: DB queries for items, route registration, page size configuration.

Deps: serde_json.

Note: Used for outbox, followers, following collections. BS uses 20 items/page. Make page_size configurable.
close_reason: All 7 modules extracted, 134 tests pass with full+db-sqlite features.
